decision: NX-036 §4 (design merged at 3b5a684; owner decided D1, D2, D3, D4, D10 and D11 on 2026-10-11: all as recommended). D1: contributions are signed off with the Developer Certificate of Origin (scripts/check_signoff.py). D2: GitHub private vulnerability reporting, optionally one more contact provided by the owner; until security_contact is filled in, SECURITY.md states that there is no formal response channel and the public gate fails. D3: response targets, not guarantees. D4: before 1.0 only the latest release is supported. D10: Contributor Covenant 2.1, adopted by reference. D11: no additional secret-scanning tool.
